name: session.category.select
title: Profile: session.category.select
description: Canonical profile for turning human seller intent into a stable categoryId.
text:
# session.category.select

TL;DR:
- Use this when you need a categoryId for draft or publish flow.
- Prefer filter.fulltext from human item description.

This profile is for seller category selection before draft create or publish.
whenToUse: The seller describes what they want to sell in natural language.
A write flow needs categoryId but the agent only has human wording.
recommended: Prefer the exact returned category id for later write calls.
Use category and group for human confirmation when several options are similar.
avoid: Do not use slug or label instead of id in seller draft and publish calls.
exampleInterpretation: Use the returned id as categoryId.
Use category for human-facing confirmation and group to disambiguate.
